name: Qilin MxMap has high value
description: Detects when the MaxMpxCt registry value is set above its default of 50, which raises the limit on simultaneous SMB requests the server will handle.
note: Hidden tripwire - no triage here. Triage via the Potential Qilin Staging Activity alert. On its own, this is usually SMB performance tuning.
false_positives: Legitimate SMB performance tuning that raises MaxMpxCt; verify via change ticket.
query:
FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-default
| WHERE host.os.type == "windows" AND event.type IN ("change", "creation") AND event.code IN ("12", "13") AND (registry.path LIKE "*LanmanServer*Parameters*MaxMpxCt" OR (registry.value == "MaxMpxCt" AND registry.path LIKE "*LanmanServer*Parameters*")) AND registry.data.type == "SZ_DWORD" AND TO_DOUBLE(MV_FIRST(registry.data.strings)) > 50
